Transaction execution and verification APIs, account setup, and compute-unit accounting helpers.

# Purpose
This header declares the transaction execution interface for the Flamenco runtime. It defines constants for account sizes, fee payer index, and compute unit accounting, and it provides the [`fd_exec_consume_cus`](<#fd_exec_consume_cus>) inline helper used to reduce the compute meter and report `FD_EXECUTOR_INSTR_ERR_COMPUTE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED` on underflow. The file also declares functions for transaction verification, account setup and loading, instruction execution, transaction execution, fee payer validation, account lock checks, and error string conversion through [`fd_executor_instr_strerror`](<#fd_executor_instr_strerror>). In addition, it exposes a small instruction stack API for fuzzing and a setup function, [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_setup`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_setup>), that initializes an execution transaction context.
